title: Feet and Inches to Cm Converter: how it works, formula and examples
excerpt: Feet and Inches to Cm Converter: Convert feet and inches to centimetres and metres. Learn how to use it, the formula behind it, a worked example and answers…
content:
The [Feet and Inches to Cm Converter](/feet-and-inches-to-cm-converter) is a free online tool on CalcHub. Convert feet and inches to centimetres and metres. Enter your feet and inches and the result appears straight away — no account or download needed. Because it runs entirely in your browser, the values you type never leave your device, and you can use it as often as you like.

Convert a height or length in feet and inches into centimetres and metres. Enter the feet and the inches separately and the result shows the metric equivalent — 5 ft 10 in is 177.8 cm, for example — plus the total in inches and millimetres. It is the reverse of the centimetres-to-feet converter, for forms, medical records, product listings and anything else that needs a metric figure. This guide explains how to use it, the formula it applies, and a worked example you can follow with your own numbers.

## How to use the Feet and Inches to Cm Converter

Start by entering your feet, then entering your inches. The result updates as you type, so adjust any value and watch the answer change. If the answer is not what you expected, check the value you entered first — a missing digit or a wrong unit is the usual cause.

1. Enter the feet — the whole number before the inches.
2. Enter the inches — the remainder after the feet.
3. Read the result in centimetres, with metres and millimetres below.

## Formula

Total inches = feet × 12 + inches. Centimetres = total inches × 2.54. Metres = centimetres ÷ 100.

That is the standard formula for this calculation, and it is the same one the [Feet and Inches to Cm Converter](/feet-and-inches-to-cm-converter) applies to the values you enter. You can work it out by hand, but the calculator is faster when you want to try several values, and it removes the risk of a slip in the arithmetic.

## Worked example

Here is a typical example. 5 ft 10 in = 70 inches × 2.54 = 177.8 cm = 1.778 m. 6 ft = 72 inches = 182.88 cm. 5 ft 4 in = 64 inches = 162.56 cm. Try the same figures in the [Feet and Inches to Cm Converter](/feet-and-inches-to-cm-converter) and you will get the same result — then change one value at a time to see how the answer moves.

## What the result shows

With the default values (Feet: 5, Inches: 10), the [Feet and Inches to Cm Converter](/feet-and-inches-to-cm-converter) returns Centimetres: 177.8 cm, Metres: 1.778 m, Total inches: 70 in, Millimetres: 1,778 mm. The first figure is the headline result, and the rest break it down so you can see how the total is made up. If you want to compare with a related calculation, the [Temperature Converter](/temperature-converter) is worth a look before you finish.

## Common heights in feet and centimetres

5 ft 0 in is 152.4 cm; 5 ft 4 in is 162.56 cm; 5 ft 7 in is 170.18 cm; 5 ft 10 in is 177.8 cm; 6 ft 0 in is 182.88 cm; and 6 ft 3 in is 190.5 cm. Each extra inch adds exactly 2.54 cm, so you can work out any height by adding 2.54 cm per inch to a figure you know.

## When forms ask for centimetres

Medical forms, visa applications, clothing sizes and many product listings ask for height in centimetres. Measure in feet and inches first if that is easier, then convert — and round to the nearest whole centimetre, since a fraction of a centimetre is smaller than the error in most measurements.

## Tips

A few things worth knowing before you rely on the result — most of them are about the numbers you put in, rather than the tool itself:

- One inch is exactly 2.54 cm, so the conversion is exact.
- Round to the nearest whole centimetre for forms — 177.8 cm is usually written as 178 cm.
- If you only know the total inches, use the Length Converter instead.

## Frequently asked questions

### How many cm is 5 ft 10 in?

177.8 cm. 5 ft 10 in is 70 inches, and 70 × 2.54 = 177.8 cm. Try it with your own numbers in the [Feet and Inches to Cm Converter](/feet-and-inches-to-cm-converter) — the result updates as you type, so you can test a few scenarios in seconds.

### How do I convert feet to cm in my head?

Multiply the feet by 30 for a rough answer (6 ft ≈ 180 cm, true value 182.88 cm). For a better estimate, multiply by 30.48. Try it with your own numbers in the [Feet and Inches to Cm Converter](/feet-and-inches-to-cm-converter) — the result updates as you type, so you can test a few scenarios in seconds.

### What is 6 feet in metres?

1.8288 metres — usually written as 1.83 m. Try it with your own numbers in the [Feet and Inches to Cm Converter](/feet-and-inches-to-cm-converter) — the result updates as you type, so you can test a few scenarios in seconds.

### What formula does the Feet and Inches to Cm Converter use?

Total inches = feet × 12 + inches. Centimetres = total inches × 2.54. Metres = centimetres ÷ 100. You can see it in action in the [Feet and Inches to Cm Converter](/feet-and-inches-to-cm-converter) — enter your own values and the result updates as you type.
